title: BigP3BCI Study L — 6x6 multi-paradigm (11 ALS subjects)
description: This dataset contains 16-channel EEG recordings from 11 participants with amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) performing a P300-based brain-computer interface speller task. The task used a 6x6 character grid with multiple stimulus paradigms, with target and non-target flashes as events. It is Study L of the larger bigP3BCI collection, which comprises about 267 subjects across 20 studies, and is distributed here as a BIDS derivative converted with MOABB.
methods_description: EEG was recorded with a g.USBamp amplifier (g.tec) at 256 Hz from 16 channels placed according to the standard 10-20 montage. Each participant completed one session of a visual P300 speller on a 6x6 grid with online feedback in a laboratory setting. Events were annotated as Target or NonTarget using HED 8.4.0 tags, with a 1.0 s trial interval.
